about: Check-in chat replies for check-chat-context.mjs (made-up students). Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

why matched.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched.reply: You were matched because you share an interest in live music and gigs, and you both enjoy similar weekends like going to the cinema. Your mentor is also laid-back, which matches what you asked for.

how often.reply: You asked to meet every two weeks. Your mentor's name and contact details are on the Your Mentor page.

checklist.reply:
You still need to join a society and find a dentist. 

For the dentist part, you can use the GP and Dentist Finder page in the app to find one near you.

who is my mentor.reply: Your mentor's name and how to get in touch are over on the Your Mentor page.

course society.ask: Can you suggest a society for my course?
course society.reply:
Since you are studying BA English Literature, you might enjoy [[English]] and [[Book]].
Have a look at those to see what you think!

why matched, waiting.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched, waiting.reply: The mentoring coordinator is currently finding you a mentor by hand, and you asked to meet weekly. Your mentor's name and how to get in touch will be on the Your Mentor page once they're matched.

why matched, no mentor.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched, no mentor.reply: You haven't been matched with a mentor yet since you haven't asked for one. You can find out more and request one on the [[Find a mentor]] page.
